user.title: Create a backdated sensor
user.description: Mirrors a numeric sensor and records each value at the time one of its attributes gives, for example when a car captured its battery level, instead of when Home Assistant received it.

data_description.source: Sensor whose numeric state is mirrored.

details.title: Capture time and unit
details.description: The unit and the classes are taken from the source sensor and can be changed.

data_description.timestamp_attribute: Attribute of the source sensor holding the time its value was captured.
data_description.state_class: Long-term statistics are kept only with a state class. Hourly statistics compiled before a backdated value arrived are then recomputed.

error.unit_not_valid: The unit of measurement does not fit the device class.
error.state_class_not_valid: The state class does not fit the device class.

init.title: Change the backdated sensor
init.description: With another source sensor, the current value stays until that sensor reports a value captured later.
